Oh what's this ? It seems untouched... Amazing ! 
*Pulling a flashlight out of her backpack, she ventures in the ruins. After 10 minutes of walk in the dark, she stumbles in a large room, a large altar standing up in the middle. As she gets closer, she can see an ancient tomb sealed on top of it, with broken vases around, containing golds*
Fabulous... I'm surely the first one walking in here in millennia... Let's see. *lighting the walls, she attempts to traduce the ancient writings*
That's not ancient greek... But it shares similarities. This temple comes from at least 1000 before Christ. *running her hands on the walls, following the writings and draws* Hmm I believe it talks about an ancient entity, living among the mortals... They built this temple for him, a place for his last rest. *She glances back at the tomb* But what kind of god were you ? Bad or good ?
*climbing back the altar, she now takes interest in the tomb, studying he drawings on the sides* It represents differents gods. Zeus, Poseidon, Hades... But I don't recognize this one. *Extending her arm, she brush her finger against the intricate carving of the unknown god. As soon as she touches it, the whole altar shakes violently as the tomb lid slowly open* Aaaaah ! *protecting her head, Emily hides against the tomb until the tremors stops* Okay... That was nothing, a simple mechanism... Time to see what you looks like. *Standing back up, she takes a look inside the tomb, furrowing her brows* Wait, why is the body not decomposed ? *Before she can probe any further, you open your eyes, making her stumble backward on her ass* What the...?!
